title: Crime Detection and Investigation
description: Methods and techniques for criminal investigation and crime scene processing.

chapters.title: Crime Scene Investigation
chapters.introduction: This chapter covers Crime Scene Investigation with 27 review items essential for the board examination.
chapters.content:
## Crime Scene Investigation

Study the following concepts and review items related to Crime Scene Investigation. Understanding these concepts is essential for passing the criminology board examination.

### Important Points to Remember:

- Safety and securing the crime scene is always the first priority to prevent contamination
- Chain of custody is the chronological documentation showing the seizure, custody, control, and disposition of evidence
- Physical evidence consists of tangible objects that can be collected and examined
- Testimonial evidence consists of statements made under oath by witnesses
- Spiral search moves from the center of the scene outward in ever-widening circles
- Grid search involves two strip searches of the same area at right angles
- The first priority is ensuring the safety of all personnel at the crime scene
- Crime scenes are secured to preserve evidence and prevent contamination

## Traffic Management

Study the following concepts and review items related to Traffic Management. Understanding these concepts is essential for passing the criminology board examination.

### Important Points to Remember:

- Traffic management aims to ensure safe, orderly, and efficient movement of vehicles and pedestrians
- The 3 Es are Engineering (road design), Education (driver training), and Enforcement (traffic laws)
- Traffic engineering involves the design of roads, signals, and traffic control systems
- Hit and run is leaving an accident scene without providing identification or assistance
- Traffic signs regulate traffic, warn of hazards, and guide road users
- A red traffic light means vehicles must stop
- Traffic engineering applies scientific principles to improve traffic flow and safety
- Traffic volume studies count vehicles to analyze traffic patterns and plan improvements

Study the following concepts and review items related to Special Crime Investigation. Understanding these concepts is essential for passing the criminology board examination.

- Cybercrime is criminal activity involving computers, networks, or the internet
- RA 10175 is the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012
- Kidnapping is the unlawful taking and detention of a person against their will
- Human trafficking involves recruiting and exploiting persons through force or deception
- Cyber forensics investigates digital devices and electronic evidence

## Drug Education and Vice Control

Study the following concepts and review items related to Drug Education and Vice Control. Understanding these concepts is essential for passing the criminology board examination.

### Important Points to Remember:

- Methamphetamine hydrochloride (Shabu) is the most commonly abused illegal drug in the Philippines
- RA 9165 is the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002
- PDEA (Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency) is the lead agency for anti-drug operations
- Drug trafficking is the illegal sale, transport, and distribution of controlled substances
- A buy-bust operation involves undercover purchase of drugs followed by immediate arrest
- Dangerous drugs are substances that can alter mental or physical functions and have abuse potential
- PDEA is the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency, the lead agency against illegal drugs
- Drug pushing is the illegal sale or distribution of dangerous drugs

## Fire Technology

Study the following concepts and review items related to Fire Technology. Understanding these concepts is essential for passing the criminology board examination.

### Important Points to Remember:

- The fire triangle consists of Heat, Fuel, and Oxygen - all three are needed for fire
- The fire tetrahedron adds chemical chain reaction to the fire triangle elements
- The point of origin is the location where the fire started
- An accelerant is a substance like gasoline used to start or accelerate the spread of fire
- The fire triangle consists of heat, fuel, and oxygen - all needed for fire
- Arson is the malicious and intentional burning of property
- The point of origin is the specific location where a fire began
- Accelerants are flammable substances used to start or spread fire in arson

## Accident Investigation

Study the following concepts and review items related to Accident Investigation. Understanding these concepts is essential for passing the criminology board examination.

### Important Points to Remember:

- Human error accounts for approximately 90% of all vehicular accidents
- A traffic accident report is the official documentation of a vehicular accident
- Skid marks help investigators determine vehicle speed and direction before impact
- Human error is the primary cause of most road accidents
- Skid marks analysis helps determine vehicle speed before an accident
- Accident reconstruction uses scientific methods to determine how an accident occurred
- Skid marks can be analyzed to determine vehicle speed before braking
- Point of impact is the exact location where vehicles or objects collided

chapters.content:
## Fundamentals of Criminal Investigation

Study the following concepts and review items related to Fundamentals of Criminal Investigation. Understanding these concepts is essential for passing the criminology board examination.

### Important Points to Remember:

- The cardinal rule is to not touch, move, or alter anything at the crime scene until properly documented
- An interview is non-accusatory questioning of witnesses or victims to gather information
- Interrogation is accusatory questioning of a suspect to obtain a confession or admission
- Modus operandi (MO) is the particular method or pattern used by a criminal in committing crimes
- A confession is a voluntary statement by a suspect admitting to committing a crime
- An admission is a statement of fact that tends to prove guilt but is not a full confession
- Criminal investigation aims to identify, apprehend, and gather evidence against offenders
- A crime scene is the location where a criminal act took place

chapters.content:
## Criminal Investigation

Study the following concepts and review items related to Criminal Investigation. Understanding these concepts is essential for passing the criminology board examination.

### Important Points to Remember:

- Surveillance involves secretly observing suspects to gather evidence
- An informant provides information to law enforcement about criminal activity
- Safety and preservation of life always takes priority before any investigative activity
- Chain of custody documents every person who handled evidence from collection to court
- Crime scene photography creates a permanent visual record of the scene as it was found
- Grid search covers an area twice, walking perpendicular paths to ensure thorough coverage
- Spiral search starts at the center (or perimeter) and moves in expanding (or contracting) circles
